name: Lane
lore: Lane hears the Reach as a choir of broken transmitters. She catches danger in the static, then turns its echo into a path no ordinary navigator could follow.

abilities.name: Witchglass Choir
abilities.text: Once per round, after you pass a Signal test, gain +1 on your next Guile check this turn.

abilities.name: Hush Static
abilities.text: Once per round, the first blue Anomaly you face has -1 difficulty.

abilities.name: Choir Lash
abilities.text: Once per round, when scenario pressure rises on your turn, gain +1 on your next Signal check this turn.
